name: Dáil Éireann
notes: 174 seats in the 34th Dáil (elected 29 November 2024). Who sits, their party and constituency are from the Oireachtas members API; the Ceann Comhairle counts as a seat. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Seanad Éireann
notes: 60 seats in the 27th Seanad (January 2025): 43 elected from five vocational panels, six by university graduates and 11 nominated by the Taoiseach. A vacancy shows as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
